cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James refers to its multiple affiliation options as AdvisorChoice®, under which financial advisors affiliate directly as either employees or independent contractors, or as employees of third-party Registered Investment Advisors and broker-dealers serviced through the RIA and Custody Services division.
items.quote: We offer multiple affiliation options, which we refer to as AdvisorChoice®. Financial advisors primarily affiliate with us directly as either employees or independent contractors or as employees of third-party Registered Investment Advisors (“RIAs”) and broker-dealers to which we provide services through our RIA and Custody Services (“RCS”) division.

items.text: AdvisorChoice® is described as a platform of dynamic options and the freedom to choose among them, letting advisors match their professional goals to the affiliation option that is right for them.
items.quote: Through AdvisorChoice®, you have the ability to match your professional goals to the affiliation option that’s right for you, each offering a unique combination of support, freedom and flexibility... AdvisorChoice® A platform of dynamic options and the freedom to choose among them.

items.text: The affiliation options listed by Raymond James include Traditional Employee, Advisor Select, Independent Contractor, Bank & Credit Union, and Corporate RIA.
items.quote: Traditional Employee: Get everything you expect from working for a firm with a powerful difference – book ownership. Advisor Select: Lead your own branch with access to administrative support and full corporate benefits. Independent Contractor: Operate as an independent financial advisor backed by the resources of a national leader. Bank & Credit Union: Leverage national strength and local impact to grow your advisory business. Corporate RIA: Exercise true autonomy and support refined for fee-only practices under our established RIA.

items.text: Employee financial advisors work in a traditional branch supported by local management and administrative staff, serve predominantly retail clients, and are compensated primarily through a payout on the revenues they generate, also participating in the firm's employee benefit plans.
items.quote: Employee financial advisors work in a traditional branch supported by local management and administrative staff. They provide services predominantly to retail clients. Compensation for these financial advisors primarily includes a payout on revenues they generate and such advisors also participate in the firm’s employee benefit plans.

items.text: Under the Traditional Employee model, advisors receive up to a 50% payout plus a full array of competitive employee benefits, with minimum 5 years of experience required.
items.quote: Model: Traditional Employee Qualifications*: Minimum 5 years of experience and production qualifications vary. Payout + Benefits: Up to 50% payout** and full array of competitive employee benefits offerings.

items.text: Under the Advisor Select model, advisors receive a 70-80% gross payout plus a full array of competitive employee benefits, and run their own branch (an employee affiliation option for advisors who want to lead a team).
items.quote: Model: Advisor Select Qualifications*: Minimum 3 years of experience and $3.5 million or higher in annual branch fees and commission revenue. Payout + Benefits: 70-80% gross payout** and full array of competitive employee benefits offerings.

items.text: Under the Independent Contractor model, advisors receive an 81% to 90% payout, and leverage Raymond James' third-party partnerships to build their own benefits package.
items.quote: Model: Independent Contractor Qualifications*: Minimum 3 years of experience. Minimum T12 of $150,000 required to join an existing branch and $400,000 to open a new branch. Payout + Benefits: 81% to 90% payout***. Leverage our third party partnerships to create a benefits package that best fits your team.

items.text: Independent contractor financial advisors are generally responsible for all of their direct costs and, accordingly, receive a higher payout percentage on the revenues they generate than employee financial advisors.
items.quote: Our financial advisors who are independent contractors are generally responsible for all of their direct costs and, accordingly, receive a higher payout percentage on the revenues they generate than employee financial advisors.

items.text: Independent payouts are higher than employee payouts because independent advisors cover their own overhead costs, real estate, health insurance, etc.; the employee side uses tiered payout systems where higher production moves an advisor up the payout grid.
items.quote: with the compensation and payouts to independent advisers versus employee advisers, of course, the independent payouts are higher because they cover their overhead costs, their real estate, their health insurance, et cetera... even on the employee side, we have tiered payout systems. And so as production increases, you kind of get higher up on the payout grid as well.

items.text: Independent contractor financial advisors may affiliate directly or through an affiliated bank or credit union in the Financial Institutions Division, and with specific approval may conduct certain other approved business activities such as insurance products, independent RIA services, and accounting and tax services.
items.quote: Independent contractor financial advisors may affiliate with us directly or through an affiliated bank or credit union in our Financial Institutions Division. With specific approval, and on a limited basis, they are permitted to conduct certain other approved business activities, such as offering insurance products, independent registered investment advisory services, and accounting and tax services.

items.text: Raymond James states it is agnostic about how an advisor affiliates (employee vs independent contractor vs RIA custody), wanting advisors to choose based on fit with its culture, values, platform and capabilities.
items.quote: we have adviser choice where we're agnostic into how you affiliate with Raymond James. We want you to fall in love with our culture, values and the platform and capabilities and how you affiliate with us, we're indifferent to.

items.text: The affiliation spectrum ranges from employee (RJA) to independent contractor (ICD) to RIA & Custody Services, described by Raymond James as servicing the largest addressable market in the industry.
items.quote: EMPLOYEE INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR RIA & CUSTODY SERVICES EMPLOYEE ADVISOR (RJA) ADVISOR SELECT INDEPENDENT ADVISOR (ICD) BANKS AND CREDIT UNIONS IAR* (CORPORATE RIA) RIA** & CUSTODY SERVICES The movement to "independence" is not channel-specific

cells.reason: Multiple passages describe in detail how Raymond James's affiliation-choice model works, including the employee and independent contractor options, their payout structures, and their cost/responsibility differences, so these are facts.
